edges.reason: msg.sender is placed into the toMint array as the mint recipient
msg.sender is checked in _isAllowedToMint, owner() and _isPublicAllowed
msg.sender drives allowance authorization and consumption in mintAndTransfer
withdraw forwards the payout to msg.sender
shake is callable by anyone and drains the whole balance to shareholders
airdrop is an unguarded external function reachable by any caller
onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) modifier validates msg.sender before update
price is compared with msg.value in the purchase requirement
setPrice writes the new price into storage
_amount is derived from withdrawable and sent out in _withdraw
_withdraw performs a full-gas external value transfer to a caller-influenced address
withdrawals[_account] is accumulated before the payout
the withdrawn total is incremented before the payout
shares[_account] determines the withdrawable amount
_mintEditions invokes _mint for each recipient
the token counter is incremented after every minted edition
purchase delegates the actual minting to _mintEditions
mint delegates the actual minting to _mintEditions
mintAndTransfer delegates the actual minting to _mintEditions
airdrop reads totals, length and minters from the allowances reference
airdrop mints tokens directly to each allowed minter
airdrop consumes allowances by updating allowedMinters
update performs unchecked storage writes to the allowances mapping
allowPublic writes the zero-address entry of allowedMinters
transferOwnership migrates the owner share to the new owner
royaltyInfo multiplies the sale value by the royalties bps
create is gated by ARTIST_ROLE and deploys a proxy against the beacon
create marks the content hash as issued in _contents
initialize populates the shareholders array through _addPayee
mint queries the allowances contract to check the caller allowance
airdrop pulls minter lists and allowances from the reference contract
the receiving contract's fallback can re-enter withdraw or purchase during the value transfer

normalization_plan.reason: _allowances is the array parameter consumed by AllowancesStore.update and has no meaning outside it
_receivers is the address array parameter iterated by AllowancesStore.updateTo, part of the same core update flow
amount is the uint16 value assigned by AllowancesStore.updateTo and collapses into the core update function
recipients is the input list of mintAndTransfer and folds into that core function
_account is the payable target parameter of _withdraw and normalizes into it
_amount is the locally computed payout inside _withdraw and collapses into that core function
start is a loop bound parameter of airdrop and folds into that core function
end is a loop bound parameter of airdrop and folds into that core function
_wei is the price argument of setPrice and normalizes into that core function
_totalShares is a local accumulator inside initialize and collapses into it
_endAt is a local clamp computed inside airdrop and collapses into it
recipient is a local loop variable in airdrop and folds into that core function
allowance is a local computed and consumed inside airdrop and collapses into it
_totalReceived is a local used by _withdraw to derive the payout and collapses into it
toMint is the single-element recipient array built by purchase and mint and folds into the mint flow
